description_short: Automatically pause or unpause machines based on electric grid capacity and headroom.
description_long: Power Threshold Governor Allows players to configure smart electricity thresholds (either as a percentage of total grid output or as an absolute Megawatt headroom reserve) to automatically throttle high-draw machines (such as Smelters, Blast Furnaces, Electric Arc Furnaces, Electrolyzers, etc.) during power strain or brownouts. Features: - Dedicated Manager Window: View live grid capacity, demand, and reserve with custom rules per machine type (Alt+P or F8 or Top HUD Icon). - Localized Machine Override: Click any machine to set instance-specific overrides directly in its inspector. - Hysteresis Protection: Built-in buffer prevents rapid flickering between on and off states.
